paragraphs: Pixel Apps is an independent software studio committed to designing intuitive and accessible artificial intelligence applications. We believe that interacting with advanced AI should feel natural, responsive, and genuinely empowering for everyone.

With AI Chatbot, our team focused on crafting a streamlined conversational experience that removes friction from daily knowledge work. By combining frontier language models with elegant interface design, Pixel Apps gives creators, professionals, and lifelong learners an intelligent partner they can rely on every single day.

faq.title: AI Chatbot Knowledge Base
faq.subtitle: Answers regarding neural architecture, context length, document security, and account setup

items.question: How does AI Chatbot maintain context across long conversation threads?
items.answer: AI Chatbot employs a state-of-the-art context window that dynamically indexes prior messages within the active thread, ensuring uninterrupted reasoning across long sessions.

items.question: What file formats can I upload for document analysis?
items.answer: You can upload standard PDF documents, Word DOCX files, plain text TXT files, and Markdown documents up to 50MB per file for instant analysis.

items.question: Are my proprietary prompts used to train public AI models?
items.answer: No. Pixel Apps enforces strict data isolation policies. Your queries, uploaded documents, and generated responses are never used to train public machine learning models.

items.question: Can AI Chatbot generate code for complete applications?
items.answer: AI Chatbot can generate architectural scaffolding, API integrations, frontend UI components, and complete script modules, along with step-by-step setup instructions.

items.question: How frequently is the underlying AI model updated?
items.answer: We continuously update our inference pipelines with the latest model releases from OpenAI and leading frontier labs, ensuring access to cutting-edge reasoning.

items.question: What should I do if AI Chatbot provides an incomplete response?
items.answer: You can simply type continue, ask for clarification, or refine your prompt. The assistant picks up precisely where it left off within the active thread.

blocks.text: The Service Provider does not independently store this information on its own servers unless explicitly stated otherwise.

If you contact the Service Provider directly, for example by email, information contained in your communication may be retained for as long as reasonably necessary to respond to your request, maintain appropriate business records, comply with legal obligations, or resolve disputes.

If you have contacted us directly or believe that we possess personal information relating to you, you may contact us at info@pixelappspk.com to request information or deletion, where applicable.

If you are a parent or legal guardian and believe that a child has provided personal information directly to the Service Provider, please contact us at info@pixelappspk.com, and we will take appropriate steps to address the request.
Users must meet the minimum age requirements applicable in their country or obtain any required consent from a parent or legal guardian.

However, because certain Application features may communicate with third-party services over the internet, no electronic transmission or processing method can be guaranteed to be completely secure.
Third-party service providers are responsible for protecting information processed through their respective systems in accordance with their own security practices and privacy policies.

You may stop using the Application at any time by uninstalling it from your device.
You may also choose not to use features that require information to be transmitted to third-party services.

Disclosure Required by Law

The Service Provider may disclose information in its possession if required to do so by applicable law, regulation, legal process, or governmental request, or when reasonably necessary to protect the rights, property, or safety of the Service Provider, its users, or others.

Any updated Privacy Policy will be made available through the Application or the location where this Privacy Policy is published. The effective date shown at the top of this Privacy Policy will be updated accordingly.
